extension_description.message: Find and open Hacker News discussions for the current article.

no_active_tab.message: No active browser tab is available.

restricted_page.message: This page is not an eligible public article.

discussion_not_found.message: No Hacker News discussion was found.

lookup_error.message: The Hacker News lookup could not be completed.

open_discussion_failed.message: Unable to open the discussion tab.

split_view_help.message: The first click opens an adjacent tab. Pair it with the article using Chrome Split View; later selections reuse that tab.

options_intro.message: Choose when Split for Hacker News may check whether the current article has a Hacker News discussion.

automatic_badge_description.message: Check article URLs as tabs navigate. When a discussion exists, show an orange badge with its comment count.

privacy_note.message: Off by default. Installed tab access is used for these checks only when this setting is on. Page contents are not read. Discussion tabs still open only after your click.

badge_available.description: Toolbar badge title when a discussion exists

badge_comments_available.description: Toolbar badge title with comment count

badge_not_found.description: Toolbar badge title when no discussion exists

badge_restricted.message: This page is not eligible for lookup
badge_restricted.description: Toolbar badge title for restricted pages

badge_lookup_failed.description: Toolbar badge title on lookup errors

open_in_side_panel.description: Side panel button in the popup

side_panel_notice.message: Hacker News blocks embedding. While this panel is open, the extension removes that block for Hacker News frames only, and restores it when you close the panel.

side_panel_open_on_hn.description: Side panel link to the full site

side_panel_empty.message: Choose a discussion in the extension popup.
